claim: The expected change in BMI between baseline and follow-up is smaller for children with a higher baseline BMI: each additional 1 kg/m2 of baseline BMI goes with a change in BMI that is at least 0.2 kg/m2 smaller (slope of at most -0.2).

data_keys.meaning: BMI of each child at the baseline visit, in kg/m2
BMI of each child at the follow-up visit five years after baseline, in kg/m2
BMI of each child of a test-retest sample at two sessions a few days apart, in kg/m2

claim: Across countries, annual lung-cancer deaths and annual cigarette sales are associated after accounting for population: the standardised slope of deaths on cigarette sales, with population accounted for, is at least 0.2 in absolute value.

data_keys.meaning: total lung-cancer deaths in each country in one year, in thousands
total cigarettes sold in each country in the same year, in millions
population of each country, in millions

claim: On future months, the monthly forecasts of a ridge regression of y on the three predictors X (penalty 1.0 on standardised predictors, with an intercept) are informative about the monthly outcome: the slope of the ordinary least squares regression of observed y on the forecast, computed over future months, is at least 0.5.

data_keys.meaning: 3 continuous monthly predictor series, one value per predictor per month
continuous monthly outcome

claim: Across skulls, cranial breadth and cranial height are positively associated after accounting for cranial length: the partial correlation coefficient between breadth and height, given length, is at least 0.2.

data_keys.meaning: maximum cranial breadth of each skull, in mm
cranial height of each skull, in mm
maximum cranial length of each skull, in mm

claim: The country-year indicators in X identify the onset of civil war in new country-years: the area under the ROC curve of a ridge-penalised logistic regression (penalty 1.0 on standardised indicators) of the onset y on X is at least 0.75.

data_keys.meaning: 25 continuous country-year indicators; an indicator that was not recorded for a country-year is NaN
True where a civil war onset occurred in the country-year

claim: A nearest-neighbour regression (one neighbour, Euclidean distance on standardised descriptors) of the response y on the descriptors X predicts y for new compounds with a Pearson correlation between predicted and observed y of at least 0.30.

data_keys.meaning: 20 continuous molecular descriptors recorded for each compound record
continuous activity response measured for each compound record

claim: A classifier built from the measurements detects the condition in new records: its sensitivity for the positive class is at least 0.60.

data_keys.meaning: measured variables of each record
True if the condition is present in the record

claim: For new subjects, a ridge regression of the trial-level outcome y on the features X (penalty 1.0 on standardised features, with an intercept) has a mean absolute error at least 5% below that of predicting the mean outcome: 1 - MAE(model) / MAE(mean predictor) >= 0.05.

data_keys.meaning: 25 continuous features computed for each trial of each subject
continuous outcome of each trial of each subject

claim: In 300 patients with a continuous disease severity score measured before and after treatment, improvement is larger in patients with a higher severity level: the Pearson correlation between each patient's change in score (follow-up minus baseline) and the mean of that patient's baseline and follow-up scores is at most -0.30.

data_keys.meaning: severity score of each patient at the baseline visit, higher is more severe
a second, independent reading of the severity score of each patient taken at the baseline visit
severity score of each patient at the follow-up visit after treatment

claim: Ten animals each received a different dose of a drug, and the response amplitude (in mV) of 100 CA3 cells was recorded in each animal. Claim: response increases with dose, that is, the slope of an animal's mean cell response on dose, across animals, is positive, judged by a one-sided test at the 0.05 level.

data_keys.meaning: response amplitude in mV of each recorded CA3 cell
dose of the drug given to each animal

claim: 600 patients with menopausal hot flushes received a treatment. Symptom severity (scale 0 to 100, higher is worse) was scored at a screening visit, again at entry on the day treatment began, and again 12 weeks later. Claim: among patients whose screening score was at least 60, at least half have a week-12 score that is 10 or more points below their entry score (proportion of at least 0.5).

data_keys.meaning: symptom severity score at the screening visit
symptom severity score at entry, on the day treatment began
symptom severity score 12 weeks after treatment began

claim: Among 40 anaesthetised dogs, whole-body oxygen consumption and oxygen delivery, each computed from the measured cardiac output and the arterial and mixed-venous blood oxygen contents by the standard Fick definitions, are positively related: their Pearson correlation is at least 0.40.

data_keys.meaning: cardiac output of each dog, in L per min
a second, independent determination of the cardiac output of each dog, in L per min
arterial blood oxygen content of each dog, in mL O2 per dL
mixed-venous blood oxygen content of each dog, in mL O2 per dL
